message: Quadratic flex interpolation (dof=quadratic) is not supported.
Flex equality constraints are not supported with sleeping enabled.
Passive contact of interpolated flexes (dof=trilinear or quadratic) is not implemented.
Self-collision of interpolated flexes (dof=trilinear or quadratic) is not implemented.
noslip solver not implemented for the discrete integrator.

what: discrete + Newton, cloth on a moving body
message: discrete integrator: flex with general attachments requires solver='CG'
flex elasticity is no longer integrated implicitly under integrator='implicit' and 'implicitfast': set integrator='discrete', or 'Euler' with a small timestep
passive flex contact requires an integrator with the effective metric: set integrator='discrete'
discrete integrator: flex edge stiffness and damping are not supported; use <elasticity> or <edge equality> instead
